public.calculator_catalog_admin sq ON sq.slug='square-calculator' JOIN public.calculator_qa_checks sample ON sample.calculator_id=sq.id AND sample.check_type=q.check_type WHERE c.slug IN ('percentage-increase-calculator','percentage-decrease-calculator','square-calculator','cube-calculator','square-root-calculator','cube-root-calculator','reciprocal-calculator','hypotenuse-calculator','triangle-area-calculator','rectangle-area-calculator','rectangle-perimeter-calculator','square-area-calculator','square-perimeter-calculator','circle-diameter-calculator','parallelogram-area-calculator','trapezoid-area-calculator','rectangular-prism-volume-calculator','pythagorean-theorem-calculator','degrees-to-radians-calculator','radians-to-degrees-calculator','percentage-change-calculator','ratio-calculator','proportion-calculator','fraction-calculator','fraction-to-decimal-calculator','average-two-numbers-calculator','gcf-calculator','factor-calculator','circle-area-calculator','circle-circumference-calculator','sphere-volume-calculator','sphere-surface-area-calculator','cylinder-volume-calculator','cone-volume-calculator','exponent-calculator','logarithm-calculator','remainder-calculator','lcm-calculator','scientific-notation-calculator','percent-error-calculator','rounding-calculator','weighted-average-two-values-calculator','decimal-to-fraction-calculator','polygon-area-calculator') GROUP BY q.check_type ORDER BY q.check_type)t),'review_event_evidence_shape',(SELECT jsonb_agg(t) FROM(SELECT c.slug,e.event_type,length(coalesce(e.notes,'')) AS
